name: Loyal Equipments Limited
about: Loyal Equipments Limited engages in designing, manufacturing, supply, erection, and commissioning of process equipment in India and internationally. The company offers pressure vessels, air-cooled heat exchangers, shell and tube heat exchangers, process skid packages, lube oil/water consoles, storage tanks, pressure receivers, chimneys, heavy structural items, process skid packages, base plates, as well as other engineered equipment for oil and gas, petroleum, chemical, sugar, steel, fertilizers, and power plant sectors. It also provides compressor and turbo packaging, and process modular packaging; and finned tubes. Loyal Equipments Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.
